messages:
emma_csm: Heads-up — Skyline Logistics (midmarket Dedicated) just hit a renewal trigger: usage down 60% month-over-month, onboarding checklist stuck at 45%. Renewal in ~38 days. Concerned about downgrade risk.

devin_support: saw the ticket. Customer reported inconsistent outputs from our latest model selection and confusion over how token billing worked for batch inference. They think charges spiked overnight.

ravi_cs: health score dropped 88 -> 49 after last two weeks. Signals: automation jobs failing, 3 support pings, 1 billing inquiry, low seat adoption.

olivia_eng: I can take a quick look at the model issue. If their nightly batch is rerunning prompts due to partial failures that could cause both quality noise and apparent sudden token usage.

emma_csm: proposed micro-play: 1) 30m enablement + billing walk-through, 2) scoped model-quality triage, 3) offer a 10-day "stability window" with token credit and a temporary conservative model pin. If it buys renewal we escalate to account exec.

devin_support: agree. I'll open a linked internal incident for the batch job. ops_bot: create task SK-9001.

ops_bot: Task created SK-9001 90-day followup disabled. Owner unassigned.

olivia_eng: quick repro ask: can the customer share a small batch (10 rows) from their nightly job? That will let me check divergence and rerun locally. Also suggest toggling "dedup_resends: true" while we investigate. Snippet to suggest: 
```
batch_job:
  dedup_resends: true
  max_retries: 1
  window_minutes: 30
```

ravi_cs: I'll coordinate the 30m session and billing review. Recommend we position the credit as a "stability credit" not a discount. Keep messaging positive. :+1:

emma_csm: Draft outreach (2 lines): "Hi <Name> 94 we noticed your nightly jobs and onboarding showed instability. Can we 30m to review the job output and billing? We'll include a short stability window credit if that helps."

devin_support: billing_bot can pre-check the invoice and call out any surge anomalies. billing_bot: can you run a quick usage anomaly for Skyline in the last 14 days?

billing_bot: Usage anomaly report attached: spike correlated with nightly job at 02:00 UTC on 1718300000. Estimated extra tokens: ~48k. Suggested next step: reduce batch concurrency or enable dedup_resends.

olivia_eng: if dedup_resends reduces duplicate hits it should cut effective token use and reduce noise in quality evals.

ops_bot: assigning SK-9001 to olivia_eng and ravi_cs. Follow-up reminder set for 1718439600.

ravi_cs: scheduled enablement call Thurs 11am ET, requested 10-row sample + any recent failing logs. I'll include a 3-question pulse at the end of the session: (1) Was the root cause addressed? (2) Did you see measurable improvement? (3) Remaining asks?

emma_csm: Good. Success criteria for the 2-week stability window: DAU recovery > 20% OR onboarding completion moves > +25%. If neither, activate downgrade-path step with clear cutoffs and exec outreach.

devin_support: finance ok for a 10-day stability credit tied to the ticket and conditional on attending the session. I'll create the billing hold and note it.

olivia_eng: I'll patch the suggested config on a staging run and send results before the call. If we find data-corruption in inputs, propose a short pre-filter stage to remove malformed rows.

emma_csm: if they accept, we'll run a micro-eval: sample 15 prompts pre/post, log latency and quality, confirm no adverse quality regressions. Capture feedback and attach to SK-9001.

ravi_cs: will handle post-session survey and next steps. If they decline the call, plan B = targeted low-touch play: weekly check-ins + graduated downgrades with clear notice.

emma_csm: great. Keep this light and helpful. Update thread after the call. :sparkles:
